auth.title: Sign in to Klupa
auth.intro: We email you a 6-digit code. No password to remember, and none stored.
auth.demoHint: No account needed. A sample under-13 squad, deleted after a week.
auth.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from the email.

welcome.title: Set up your club
welcome.intro: Two details and you are on the pitch. You can change both later.
welcome.demoNote: It comes with an invented season, so every screen has something in it.

home.title: Today
home.subtitle: {{team}} · {{club}}
home.loadFailed: Today's overview could not be loaded.

rings.title: Where the team stands
rings.detail: Across the season so far. Tap a measure to see how it is worked out.

needs.title: What needs you
needs.none: Nothing needs you right now. The rings above are where things stand.
needs.load_one: Training load rose sharply this week for {{count}} player, up to {{ratio}}× their usual.
needs.load_few: Training load rose sharply this week for {{count}} players, up to {{ratio}}× their usual.
needs.load_other: Training load rose sharply this week for {{count}} players, up to {{ratio}}× their usual.
needs.secondLook_one: {{count}} player is owed a second look: fewer than {{min}} attempts observed.
needs.secondLook_few: {{count}} players are owed a second look: fewer than {{min}} attempts observed each.
needs.secondLook_other: {{count}} players are owed a second look: fewer than {{min}} attempts observed each.

focus.lostOwnHalf: Last match: {{lost}} balls lost in your own half. Suggested focus: {{focus}}.
focus.entriesWithoutShots: Last match: {{entries}} box entries but only {{shots}} shots. Suggested focus: {{focus}}.
focus.opponentHighRecoveries: Last match: the opponent won the ball high {{recoveries}} times. Suggested focus: {{focus}}.
focus.fewHighRecoveries: Last match: you won the ball high {{ours}} times, the opponent {{theirs}}. Suggested focus: {{focus}}.
focus.chanceQualityGap: Last match: their chances added up to {{theirs}} xG, yours to {{ours}}. Suggested focus: {{focus}}.

needs.pitch_one: {{count}} session would have fitted a smaller pitch, freeing {{hours}} pitch-hours.
needs.pitch_few: {{count}} sessions would have fitted a smaller pitch, freeing {{hours}} pitch-hours.
needs.pitch_other: {{count}} sessions would have fitted a smaller pitch, freeing {{hours}} pitch-hours.

match.title: Last match
match.none: No finished match yet. Record one and how it went appears here.
match.strip: Who was on top, through the match: {{summary}}.
match.noEvents: No events were tagged in this match.
match.eventsFailed: The match's events could not be loaded.
match.openLabel: Open the review of the match against {{opponent}}

squad.title: Add your squad
squad.body: A label and a shirt number for each player. No names needed.

match.title: Record a match
match.body: Two taps per event, at the touchline.

training.title: Plan training
training.body: A session that fits the players, pitch and time you have.

demo.title: Your demo club is empty
demo.body: Load an invented season of matches and training to see every screen with real numbers. None of it is about real children.

more.title: Go deeper

evidence.title: The evidence
evidence.body: Why one momentum chart is not enough: our tests on professional matches.

more.labsNote: Experiments we are trying out. They may change.

movement.title: Match replay
movement.body: A professional match in 3D: every player, team shape and who controls which space.

shot.title: Shot lab
shot.body: A kick analysed on your phone from a short clip: strike, knee, trunk and standing foot.

pro.title: Pro matches
pro.body: The same engine reading all 115 matches of the 2018 World Cup and Euro 2016; your own matches are read the same way.

errors.offline: No connection. Check your signal and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid: That did not look right. Check the details and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That address does not lead anywhere in Klupa.

landing.title: The match, read honestly.
landing.lead: Tap what happens from the touchline. Klupa shows who was on top, how far to trust it, what to train on Monday and who is still owed minutes.
landing.signInDetail: For coaches already using Klupa, or starting a real club.

replay.title: A whole match, in three dimensions.
replay.body: Real player tracking from seven professional matches. Turn the pitch, follow one player, read the physical report.
replay.label: Players moving on a pitch drawn in 3D, from the tracking data of a professional match.

reading.title: Who was on top. And how far to trust it.
reading.body: Three time windows are read at once. When they disagree, Klupa says so instead of drawing one confident line.
reading.label: An example: three lines for the last 3, 5 and 10 minutes. Where they point at different teams, the verdict is that it depends on the window.

fair.title: Every child gets minutes.
fair.body: Playing time, attention and effort, counted across the season.
fair.label: An example of the three season rings

final.title: A final, as it happened.
final.body: 115 professional matches play back minute by minute: the score, the chances, the passing network, the territory.

shot.title: A strike, measured on the phone.
shot.body: Point the camera at a kick and read the movement as a skeleton, joint by joint.
shot.figure: pictures leave the phone. The analysis runs on the device.
shot.overlay: Follow the players in a video

research.title: Checked against real matches.
research.body: How often a 3-minute and a 10-minute view of the same match point at opposite teams.
research.figure: {{share}} of the moments where both views lean, across {{matches}} matches.

matchday.title: One tap on the touchline. The whole bench sees it.
matchday.body: The coach taps what happens, even with no signal. Anyone in the club watching on another phone sees the score, who is on top and how far to trust it.
matchday.label: An example of the live match centre during a match: the under-13s lead the visitors 2 to 1 and are on top.
